physical.title: helmet
physical.summary: Gourd helmet, stitched all over with cowrie shells in concentric bands. A strip of cotton cloth is stitched along the crest of the helmet and falls as a 120cm pendant, ending in a brown leather tassle with black and white plaited binding. The cotton strip is edged with black leather and white leather stitching. An appliqued white leather strip with diamond shaped cutouts runs centrally along the cloth, stitched with black cotton. The surface of the cotton cloth is very worn but shows evidence of woven threads and red wool. Two 14cm teardrop shaped pendants of similar design are attached with leather bindings to both sides of the helmet. Each pendant ends in lenghths of plaited brown leather joined together with leather bindings. Fixed to the top of the helmet is the remains of an animal tail [horse ?] encased in cotton with evidence of red wool.
